verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a first-party docs page titled "OpenTelemetry in Datadog". It implies Datadog accepts OpenTelemetry-instrumented telemetry, which is the open-standards path that would allow backend portability. The pack gives no detail beyond that title. Missing for 10: documentation that OTel SDK/Collector data is ingested without Datadog-proprietary instrumentation, evidence of feature parity for OTel data versus native agents/libraries, explicit backend-switching or vendor-neutrality guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
